map.记录演练疏散人数、楼层数与起止时间，算出总时长、人员流量与每层用时。: Record the number of evacuees, floors and start/end times of a drill to compute total duration, personnel flow and time per floor.
map.对比预案目标时间，评估是否达标并定位最慢环节。: Compare against the target time in the emergency plan to see whether it passes and locate the slowest stage.
map.多轮数据归档，跟踪演练改进效果。: Archive data across multiple rounds to track the effect of drill improvements.
map.疏散总时长 = 结束 − 开始；流量 = 疏散人数 ÷ 总时长；每层平均用时 =: Total evacuation duration = end − start; flow = evacuees ÷ total duration; average time per floor = people on that floor ÷ (people on that floor ÷ floor time); pass rule: total duration ≤ plan target with nobody left behind.
map.5 层办公楼 600 人，9:00 开始、9:07:30 结束（450 秒），流: A 5-floor office building with 600 people starts at 9:00 and ends at 9:07:30 (450 seconds), giving a flow of 600/7.5 = 80 people/minute; among them the 2nd floor with 150 people took 180 seconds (0.83 people/second), the slowest, while other floors were about 1.2 people/second, so the 2nd floor exit should be upgraded first.
map.若逐层记录到达集结点时间，用相邻层到达时间差除以该层人数；无逐层数据则用总人数/: If you record arrival times at the assembly point floor by floor, divide the arrival time difference between adjacent floors by the number of people on that floor; without per-floor data, approximate the overall flow with total people ÷ total duration.
map.演练评估只看时间吗？: Does drill assessment only look at time?
map.时间外还要核对疏散路线畅通、指引标识清晰、特殊人群（行动不便）有人协助，以及集合: Besides time, check that evacuation routes are clear, signage is legible, special populations (those with limited mobility) have assistance, and the assembly point roll call confirms everyone arrived.
map.疏散时长 = 结束时间 − 开始时间，若结束早于开始则按跨天 +24 小时计算: Evacuation duration = end time − start time; if the end is earlier than the start, treat it as crossing midnight with +24 hours
map.楼层基准时长 = 60 秒基础 + 楼层数 × 30 秒/层，作为「良好」效率参: Floor baseline duration = 60 seconds base + number of floors × 30 seconds per floor, used as the reference threshold for "good" efficiency
map.评估参考 GB 50016《建筑设计防火规范》疏散时间原则，实际应结合场所疏散通: The assessment references the evacuation time principles of GB 50016, and in practice should be combined with the site's evacuation passage conditions
map.本工具纯前端运行，数据不会上传到服务器，结果仅供演练复盘参考: This tool runs purely in the browser and never uploads data to the server; results are for drill review reference only
map.关于「应急演练计时与评估表」: About "Emergency Drill Timing and Assessment Sheet"
map.应急演练计时与评估表工具，输入疏散人数、楼层数与起止时间，自动计算疏散总时长、疏: An emergency drill timing and assessment sheet tool. Enter the number of evacuees, floors and start/end times to automatically compute total evacuation duration, evacuation flow and time per floor, then give an efficiency rating and remediation suggestions against the per-floor baseline. Pure front-end processing with no data upload.
